notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Sami
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Sami
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.
